documents.title: Sliver receiving device and method for forming same
documents.abstract: The invention relates to a sliver receiving device for supplying a sliver coming from a drafting system to a yarn-forming element of a spinning device, an air jet spinning device and a method for forming a sliver receiving device for supplying a sliver coming from a drafting device to a yarn-forming element of a spinning device. The sliver receiving device according to the invention comprises a main body having an inlet opening for receiving the sliver supplied from the drafting system, and a sliver guide device arranged behind the inlet opening for the defined supplying of the sliver to the yarn-forming element.

documents.title: Downhole fluid tracking with distributed acoustic sensing
documents.abstract: Various disclosed distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) based systems and methods include embodiments that process the DAS measurements to detect one or more contrasts in acoustic signatures associated with one or more fluids flowing along a tubing string, and determine positions of the one or more contrasts as a function of time. The detected contrasts may be changes in acoustic signatures arising from one or more of: turbulence, frictional noise, acoustic attenuation, acoustic coupling, resonance frequency, resonance damping, and active noise generation by entrained materials. At least some of the contrasts correspond to interfaces between different fluids such as those that might be pumped during a cementing operation. Certain other method embodiments include acquiring DAS measurements along a borehole, processing the measurements to detect one or more acoustic signature contrasts associated with interfaces between different fluids in the borehole, and responsively displaying a position of at least one of said interfaces.

documents.title: A kind of leaky waveguide and preparation method thereof
documents.abstract: The present invention relates to waveguide devices field, the structure and production method of specially a kind of leaky waveguide.Existing leaky waveguide intensity is low, at high cost.Novel leaky waveguide of the invention, it is made of inner core 1, foaming layer 2, outer conductor layer 3, oversheath 4, the inner core 1 is in innermost layer, inner core 1 is core wire, there is foamed material producing foamed layer 2 outside it, it will be wrapped in again with apertured sheet metal strip outside foaming layer 2 and be made into outer conductor layer 3, the oversheath 4 being made by insulating materials is made up outside outer conductor layer 3 of extrusion process.The present invention contains inner core and uses foam material as medium, greatly improves the structural strength of product, unique foaming cutting technique so that the shape of product after foaming more preferably controls, allow all kinds of shapes waveguide cost all in reasonable interval.

documents.title: Seal for gap between shaft and housing comprises roller bearing and cassette which are biased towards each other by annular spring
documents.abstract: The seal for the gap between a shaft (3) and a housing (2) comprises a roller bearing (1) and a cassette seal (4). An annular spring (7) with axial flexibility is positioned between these to bias them towards each other.

documents.title: A vehicle roof fairing and method of installing.
documents.abstract: The present invention relates to a roof fairing body and a method of installing a roof fairing on a vehicle. The roof fairing includes a lower fairing body section, an upper fairing body section, a shipping configuration, and an operable configuration. The lower fairing body section includes a front wall and side walls extending rearward from opposite ends of the front wall. The front wall and side walls cooperate to define an upper roof fairing section receiving space. The upper fairing body section is configured to mate with the lower fairing body section to form at least one hinge. When in the shipping configuration, the upper roof fairing section is positioned at least partially within the upper roof fairing section receiving space of the lower fairing body section, whereby the roof fairing body is provided with a shipping height and the upper roof fairing section and the lower fairing body section mate to form at least one hinge. When in an operable configuration the upper roof fairing section pivots about the at least one hinge whereby the upper roof fairing section is situated at least partially above the lower fairing body section and the roof fairing body is provided with an operable height that is greater than the shipping height.

documents.title: Methods for enhancing the bioavailability and exposure of a voltage-gated potassium channel opener
documents.abstract: In certain embodiments, the present disclosure is directed to methods and uses for treating seizure disorders in a human, wherein the methods and uses comprise orally administering a therapeutically effective amount of the voltage-gated potassium channel allosteric modulator, N-[4-(6-fluoro-3,4-dihydro-1H-isoquinolin-2-yl)-2,6-dimethylphenyl]-3,3- dimethylbutanamide (Compound A), to the human in need thereof, for example, under fed conditions. The present disclosure is further directed to various improved methods of therapy and administration of Compound A.

documents.title: Dirty clothing is collected with indoor mouth of puting in with preventing tong function
documents.abstract: The utility model relates to the field of clothes collection, and particularly discloses an indoor throwing-in port with a hand clamping prevention function for collecting dirty clothes. The in-process of end cover connecting rod pulling downwards can drive the upper end cover and rotate to open the upper end of collecting the box, the whole in-process of uncapping liberates both hands, conveniently places dirty clothes and also prevents that the lid from can the tong simultaneously, and the baffle can be placed with the inner box baffle of collecting the box inboard, when needs wash the clothing, conveniently takes out interior box with a net from the collecting box body.

documents.title: Escabeau
documents.abstract: L'escabeau selon l'invention comprend notamment (i) des montants (4) d'une section aux marches (1) courbés et s'élargissant en direction de la base de l'escabeau, (ii) des montants (7) de la section d'appui (2) s'élargissant en direction de la base l'escabeau et sont complémentaires de la forme courbée des montants (4) la section aux marches (1) ; (iii) le raccordement des montants (4) de la section aux marches (1) et des montants (7) de la section d'appui (2) est réalisé par des cavités (11) d'une forme arrondie réalisées dans les montants (4) de la section aux marches (1) et raccordées a une oreille arrondie (8) des montants (7) de la section d'appui (2) avec la possibilité d'un déplacement réciproque et la formation d'un jeu fonctionnel (22) entre la cavité (11) et l'oreille arrondie (8) dans la partie supérieure de la cavité (11) à l'état replié de l'escabeau, et avec la formation d'un jeu fonctionnel dans la partie inférieure de la cavité à l'état ouvert de l'escabeau.

documents.title: Photoelectric device
documents.abstract: A photoelectric device comprising: a substrate; a first conductive semiconductor layer situated over a first surface of the substrate; a second conductive semiconductor layer situated over the said first surface of the substrate; a first electrode situated over the first conductive semiconductor layer; and a second electrode situated over the second conductive semiconductor layer; wherein one of the first and second conductive semiconductor layers is an emitter layer and the other of the first and second conductive semiconductor layers is a base layer; characterised in that the first conductive semiconductor layer covers a greater proportion of the said first surface of the substrate than the second conductive semiconductor layer covers.

documents.title: Led lamp apparatus
documents.abstract: PURPOSE: An LED(Light Emitting Diode) device is provided to extend the lifetime of an LED chip by discharging the heat from the LED chip through a heat radiation plate. CONSTITUTION: An LED assembly(20) is mounted on a base(10). An LED assembly comprises a PCB(Printed Circuit Board)(21) and a reflector(22). The LED chip is mounted on the PCB. The reflector is mounted on the base. The reflector includes a penetration hole and an incline part. The penetration hole exposes the LED chip. The incline part is formed around the penetration hole. The height of the incline part is equal to the height of the LED chip.

documents.title: Fan blade structure for a kitchen ventilator
documents.abstract: The present invention relates to fan blade structure for a kitchen ventilator, wherein the fan blades are radially disposed between the top hub and the bottom hub, and the windward portion of the fan blade is larger than the leeward portion. The leeward portion of the fan blade is curved outward, and the air duct defined by the fan blades, the top and the bottom hub tapers increasingly one end to the other, so that the smoke and oil air can be exhausted by the curved leeward portion without causing turbulent flow in the air duct. The ventilator can work smoothly and quietly. In addition, the fan blade is formed with different angles both in axial direction and in radial direction, so that the fan blade is greatly curved and has a relatively large air guide area, and can produce a strong air pressure.

documents.title: Elektro-eğirme tekniğiyle nikel ve bor katkılı termoelektrik sodyum kobalt oksit nano kompozit üretim  yöntemi ve üretimi.
documents.abstract: Bu patent elektro-eğirme tekniği kullanarak tercihen nikel katkılı sodyum kobalt oksit üretim yöntemi ve üretimidir. Elektro-eğrilecek polimer malzemesi olarak tercihen polivinil alkol olarak adlandırılan PVA, poliakrilo nitril olarak adlandırılan PAN, polivinil asetat olarak adlandırılan PVAc gibi diğer polimerler tek tek ya da hibrit kopolimer olarak yani ikili ya da üçlü karışımlar olarak da kullanılmaktadır.Sodyum kaynağı olarak tercihen sodyum asetat istenirse sodyum nitrat, kobalt kaynağı olarak tercihen kobalt asetat istenirse kobalt nitrat, nikel kaynağı olarak tercihen nikel asetat istenirse nikel nitrat buluşta kullanılabilmektedir.istenirse bor oksit katkısı da patentte mümkün olup bor kaynağı olarak da tercihen borik asit kullanılmaktadır. Elektro-eğrilmiş nano-lifler tercihen 1000 "C'de tercihen hava ortamında kalsine edilmekte, elde edilen seramik malzemedeki karbonun ortamdan tam olarak uzaklaştırılamaması ve seramik malzemenin istenilen düzeyde saf olmaması durumunda istenirse kalsine edilmiş ürün tercihen aynı sıcaklıkta tercihen hava ortamında tekrar ısıl işlemden geçirilirmektedir. Daha sonra malzeme istenirse öğütücülerden geçirilerek tercihen pelet haline dönüştürülmektedir.

documents.title: Method and device for monitoring an insertion system for a weaving machine
documents.abstract: Method and device for monitoring an insertion system (10) for a weaving machine, in which the device (1) comprises a sensor device (2) for measuring at least one actual value of a fluid stream and a processing device (6) connected to the sensor device (2) for comparing a measured actual value of the fluid stream with an expected value for the fluid stream.

documents.title: Elemento de construccion y uso de un elemento de construccion asi como procedimiento para la fabricacion de un elemento de construccion.
documents.abstract: Elemento de construcción, en especial elemento de fachada, que separa una zona fría (5) de una zona caliente (6), con una guía de marco que presenta un perfil de cámara hueca (11) de plástico y un soporte (1) dispuesto entre la zona fría (5) y la zona caliente (6), que presenta una pieza de soporte exterior dispuesta por fuera de la zona fría (5) y una pieza de soporte interior dispuesta por dentro de la zona caliente (6), fabricándose el soporte de un solo material, a saber, acero y disponiéndose como armadura dentro de una cámara hueca del perfil de cámara hueca, caracterizado porque el soporte entre la pieza de soporte exterior (2) y la pieza de soporte interior (3) presenta líneas de agujeros dispuestos desplazados unos de otros.

documents.title: Fuel furnace "natalie"
documents.abstract: The fuel furnace has case with inlet opening, furnace with grate, this has a loading hatch with cover, ashpit with hatch for extraction of the combustion products and heat exchanger connected to the smoke suction unit. The furnace has openings, the ashpit is connected by branch pipe to heat exchanger and has reflector placed under the grate; at that in the housing of the ashpit, in front of the reflector, there are provided openings for feeding heated air.

documents.title: Устройство для подготовки серы к сжиганию
documents.abstract: Полезная модель относится к области химической технологии и может найти применение в целлюлозно-бумажной промышленности для приготовления серной и сернистой кислот. Полезная модель позволяет получить технический результат, заключающийся в повышении степени очистки серы для сжигания. Устройство для подготовки серы к сжиганию включает средство для доставки расплавленной серы, приемную емкость, хранилище, систему очистки серы от примесей и оборудование для подачи серы на сжигание. Устройство снабжено расходной емкостью, нижняя часть которой соединена сливным трубопроводом с хранилищем, причем соотношении размеров хранилища и расходной емкости выбрано равным 7:1. 1 с.п. ф-лы. 1 илл.

documents.title: Phaffia-celle, Phaffia rhodozyma, E. coli, fremgangsmÕte for transformering og fremstilling av Phaffia celler samtfremgangsmÕte for fremstilling av et önsket produkt
documents.abstract: The present invention discloses a transformed Phaffia strain. Also disclosed are specific vectors for transforming Phaffia, preferably such vectors contain expression regulating sequences obtained from Phaffia. The present invention also discloses the use of certain marker genes in Phaffia. The invention further discloses a method for transforming Phaffia.

documents.title: Στερεα φαρμακευτικα σκευασματα που περιεχουν bibw 2992
documents.abstract: Η παρούσα εφεύρεση αφορά μια φαρμακοτεχνική μορφή που περιέχει την δραστική ουσία BIBW 2992 ως διμηλεϊνικό άλας, η οποία παρέχει προφίλ άμεσης αποδέσμευσης της δραστικής ουσίας, περαιτέρω η εφεύρεση αφορά συμπαγή ενδιάμεσα προϊόντα που περιέχουν διμηλεϊνικό άλας της BIBW 2992 (BIBW 2992 ΜΑ2) σε μορφή κόνεως, παρασκευασμένης με συνδυασμένη συμπίεση μεταξύ κυλίνδρων και κοσκίνισμα της BIBW 2992 ΜΑ2, μείγματα ενδιάμεσου προϊόντος, παρασκευασμένα από τα αναφερόμενα συμπαγή ενδιάμεσα προϊόντα καθώς και χορηγούμενα από του στόματος στερεά σκευάσματα που παρέχουν προφίλ άμεσης αποδέσμευσης της δραστικής ουσίας, παρασκευασμένα από τα αναφερόμενα συμπαγή ενδιάμεσα προϊόντα ή από τα αναφερόμενα μείγματα ενδιάμεσου προϊόντος έτοιμα για χρήση/λήψη, π.χ. σκευάσματα καψακίων και δισκίων όπως μη επικαλυμμένα ή επικαλυμμένα με λεπτό υμένιο δισκία, παρασκευασμένα με απευθείας συμπίεση, και μεθόδους για την παραγωγή τους.

documents.title: Verfahren zum senden und empfangen einer mitteilungsbenachrichtigung und vorrichtung dafür
documents.abstract: The present invention related to a a notification message receiving apparatus comprising an Internet protocol (IP) decapsulator (120) configured to decapsulate an IP packet carrying notification messages over a network, a user datagram protocol (UDP) decoder (130) configured to decode the decapsulated IP packet in accordance with an UDP and to output a real-time protocol (RTP) packet, an RTP decoder (140) configured to decode the RTP packet, to acquire, from the RTP packet, information describing a notification type of each of a plurality of notification messages, when there is the plurality of notification messages in the RTP packet, to output the plurality of notification messages in accordance with the acquired information, and a first notification parser (155) configured to parse the notification messages.

documents.title: Dispositif d'echange de chaleur et procede de fabrication d'un element d'echange de chaleur pour un dispositif d'echange de chaleur
documents.abstract: La présente invention concerne un dispositif d'échange de chaleur, en particulier radiateur de véhicule pour un véhicule automobile, pour l'échange indirect de chaleur entre un premier milieu et un second milieu, avec une première partie de guidage (12a) pour le guidage du premier milieu et une seconde partie de guidage (12b) pour le guidage du second milieu, la première partie de guidage (12a) étant formée par un élément d'échange de chaleur (10) thermoconducteur, se composant d'une mousse de graphite et étant séparée dans l'espace de la seconde partie de guidage (12b), au moins une partie de la seconde partie de guidage (12b) étant formée par l'élément d'échange de chaleur (10).L'invention concerne également un procédé de fabrication d'un élément d'échange de chaleur (10) pour un dispositif d'échange de chaleur, en particulier pour un radiateur de véhicule d'un véhicule automobile.

documents.title: Mechanical vending machine for selling elongate articles
documents.abstract: Mechanický prodejní automat pro prodej podlouhlých výrobků má skříň, ve které je otáčivě uložen zásobník vytvořený jako buben (20) sestávající z více zásobníkových kotoučů (30, 31, 32) s radiálně uspořádanými komorami (33) pro postupné vydávání podlouhlých výrobků uložených v jednotlivých komorách (33). K bubnu (20) alespoň v jeho spodní polovině přiléhá kryt (60) mající v nejnižším místě podélný otvor (61) nebo řadu otvorů, jejichž rozměr odpovídá rozměru ústí (34) komor (33). Na přední straně prvního zásobníkového kotouče (31) je připevněno ozubené kolo (40), které je v záběru s ústrojím pro pootáčení bubnu (20), které je ve spojení s platebním zařízením pro umožnění, po zaplacení požadovaného obnosu, pootočení prvního zásobníkového kotouče (31) vždy o úhel odpovídající úhlovému odstupu sousedních komor (33). Zásobníkové kotouče (30, 31, 32) jsou opatřeny prostředky pro postupné připojení vždy následujícího zásobníkového kotouče (30, 32) pro vydání podlouhlých výrobků ze všech komor předcházejícího zásobníkového kotouče (30, 31).

documents.title: Compuestos y metodos para aislar oro
documents.abstract: En una primera instancia, se presenta un primer metodo para aislar oro de materiales auriferos. El metodo comprende varios pasos. En el primer paso, se anade HX y acido a los materiales auriferos para formar una primera solucion de oro disuelto. El HX es un haluro de hidrogeno. En el segundo paso, se anade una base a la primera solucion de oro disuelto para formar una segunda solucion de oro disuelto. En el tercer paso, se anade ciclodextrina a la segunda solucion de oro disuelto para formar un precipitado en la segunda solucion de oro disuelto. En el cuarto paso, se aisla el precipitado de la segunda solucion de oro disuelto. El precipitado comprende oro en la forma de un complejo de oro-ciclodextrina. En una segunda instancia, se presenta un segundo metodo para aislar oro de materiales auriferos. El metodo comprende varios pasos. El primer paso es generar una solucion que comprenda hipobromito de sodio o hipobromito de potasio. El segundo paso es anadir la solucion al material aurifero para formar una primera solucion de oro di suelto. El tercer paso es anadir ciclodextrina a la primera solucion de oro disuelto para formar un precipitado en la solucion de oro disuelto. El cuarto paso es aislar el precipitado de la primera solucion de oro disuelto. El precipitado comprende un complejo de oro -ciclodextrina. documents.title: Abdominal instrument
documents.abstract: A surgical instrument (100) for placement of a movement restriction device (110,210,310) for use in a surgical procedure for treating reflux disease in a patient. The instrument comprises a sleeve (113) and a holding device (111) configured to engage the movement restriction device, wherein the holding device is configured to be placed within the sleeve and be displaceable in relation to the sleeve. The instrument further comprises a first handling portion (101) connected to the sleeve, and a second handling portion (102) connected to the holding device. The handling of at least one of the first and second handling portion creates relative displacement of the holding device in relation to the sleeve, which disengages the holding device from the movement restriction device for performing the placement of the movement restriction device.

documents.title: False-twisted yarn of polyester, method for producing the same and woven or knitted fabric
documents.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a false-twisted yarn of a polyester having proper low delayed recovery suitable as a stretch material without causing wrinkles and grains compared to a conventional polytrimethylene terephthalate textured yarn, and further to provide a method for producing the false-twisted yarn and a woven or knitted fabric. SOLUTION: This false twisted yarn of the polyester comprises the polytrimethylene terephthalate and has <=5% delayed recovery.

documents.title: Mode transition method of mobile station for wireless data service
documents.abstract:
본 발명은 음성과 데이터 서비스를 지원하는 이동통신 시스템에서 데이터 서비스를 위한 이동 단말기의 상태를 천이하는 방법에 대한 것이다. 제어홀드 상태의 이동 단말기는 기지국으로부터 수신되는 순방향 웨이크-업 채널상의 할당된 타임슬롯에서 웨이크-업하여 미리 정해지는 적어도 하나의 지시비트를 검출하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 지시비트가 상기 기지국에서 전송하는 데이터가 있음을 지시하면, 활성화모드로 천이할 것인지를 판단하기 위하여 상기 기지국으로부터의 순방향 패킷 데이터 제어 채널을 모니터링하기 시작한다. 반면 상기 적어도 하나의 지시비트가 상기 기지국에서 전송할 데이터가 있음을 지시하지 않으면, 제어홀드 상태를 유지하여 전력의 낭비를 방지한다. 이로써 본 발명은 기지국의 무선자원을 절약하고 이동 단말기의 전력소모를 최소화 할 수 있다.  
       
     1XEV-DV, 활성화모드, 제어홀드모드, 상태천이, MAC protocol, F-WUCH

documents.title: Tubular air conditioner
documents.abstract: Przedmiotem wynalazku jest klimatyzator rurowy posiadający pierścień, łopatki i silnik. Charakteryzuje się on tym, że składa się z rury doprowadzającej powietrze (1.1) zamocowanej do pierwszej podstawy pierścienia klimatyzatora (2) z rozmieszczonymi na jego obwodzie zwężającymi się przelotowymi otworami. W otworach znajdują się ogniwa Peltiera. Do powierzchni ogniw Peltiera znajdujących się na zewnętrznej stronie pierścienia klimatyzatora (2) zamocowane są pierwsze radiatory (4). Do powierzchni ogniw Peltiera znajdujących się na wewnętrznej stronie pierścienia klimatyzatora (2) zamocowane są drugie radiatory (5). Do drugiej podstawy pierścienia klimatyzatora (2) zamocowana jest rura odprowadzająca powietrze (1.2).

documents.title: Electronic lateral flow test arrangement and method
documents.abstract: A lateral test flow arrangement for a test molecule is disclosed, comprising: a test strip for transporting an analyte away from a sampling region and towards an absorbing region, the test strip having therein and remote from the sampling region, a test region for functionalization with a molecule which binds to the test molecule or to a conjugate of the test molecule; a sensing test capacitor having electrodes extending across the test strip at least partially aligned with the test region and being physically isolated therefrom; a reference test capacitor having electrodes extending across the test strip and being physically isolated therefrom; and an electronic circuit configured to measure a time-dependant capacitance difference between the sensing test capacitor and the reference test capacitor. A method for carrying out that lateral flow tests is also disclosed, as are test systems and in particular pregnancy test systems.

documents.title: Rotationswerkzeug
documents.abstract: The rotary tool is in the form of a rubber or soft plastic washer (1) with an outer crown and an inner crown. The outer crown forms a toothed crown with elastic teeth, and the inner one is for connecting to a rotating holder. There are stabilizing webs (6) offset width and height between the machining teeth (4) in the circumferential direction of the outer crown, forming a joint with the machining teeth.

documents.title: Method for the preparation of an iron-containing complex compound [fe(ncs)2(ligand)] with a sharp spin transition at a temperature close to the freezing point of water
documents.abstract: Method for the preparation of an iron-containing complex compound [Fe(NCS)2(ligand)] with a sharp spin transition at a temperature close to the freezing point of water, which involves the reaction of complexation of ligand L1 and iron salt [Fe(NCS)2(py)4]. The ligand L1 is 2,2-dimethyl-N,N'-bis((1-fluoropropyl-1H-1,2,3-triazol-4-yl)methylene)propane-1,3-diamine, and the complexation reaction is carried out in a boiling methanol medium in the presence of ascorbic acid as a reducing agent.

documents.title: Production process of moisture-absorbing and heating fabric
documents.abstract: The invention discloses a production process of a moisture-absorbing and heating fabric, which comprises the following steps: weaving → pretreatment → dyeing → dehydration → cutting width → drying → shaping → compound shaping → finished product, wherein: (1) in the weaving process: the fabric is woven by moisture absorption heating fibers with the fineness of 12-18S and blended yarns of 32-40S on a towel single-side machine according to the weaving mode of flannelette, the blended yarns are face yarns, the moisture absorption heating fibers are terry yarns, the blended yarns are formed by blending cotton and terylene, and the mass percentage of each component in the fabric is as follows: 23.3-24.6% of moisture-absorbing and heat-generating fibers, 44.7-46.6% of cotton and 30.1-30.7% of terylene. The dyeing method has the advantages of safety, environmental protection and uniform fabric dyeing.

documents.title: Wellhead system and method of operating a wellhead system
documents.abstract: A system for orienting a tubing hanger assembly in a wellhead assembly 12 includes a landing assembly 26 having a tubing hanger 30 and an orientation means with extendable means 48 for engaging with an interior surface of the wellhead assembly, a control means having a motor 50 and a drive part 52 which is configured to rotate the tubing hangers relative to the wellhead when the extendable means are engaged with the wellhead. The system may have a soft landing system operable to allow tubing hanger downward movement through a travel distance after engagement with the wellhead between an initial landing position and a final landing position, such as by a spring carrier (fig. 9, 109)

documents.title: Method and system for database-driven, scalable web page development, deployment-download, and execution
documents.abstract: A system and method for Web page development, deployment, download, and execution include and utilize a Web page development computer (110), a server computer (140), and a client computer (170). Development computer initializes (301) a page development tool which a developer uses to creat a Web page document by placing components (320) on a Web page (220), whereupon the tool incorporates (324) executable code into the Web page document. Server computer stores the Web page document and, upon client computer request, retrieves (714) and sends (716) the Web page document to client computer. Client computer receives the Web page document and displays the corresponding Web page. If the Web page includes a database-related component, client computer requests (1030) data from server computer. After receiving (1032) the corresponding data, the data is displayed (1032) within the database-related component, and state variables are stores (1034) for later use.

documents.title: Chimney lining material comprising a cement binder and filler aggregate, contains a mixture of a water reducing agent and an air entraining agent
documents.abstract: The material contains a mixture of a water-reducing agent and an air entraining agent.  A chimney ramming material for lining chimneys, especially brick chimneys, comprises a cement binder, filler aggregate and a mixture of a water-reducing agent and an air entraining agent. Independent claims are also included for (a) the preparation of the material by adding colloidal silica to cement comprising sand and volcanic aggregates, then slowly adding most of the water, and then adding a water-reducing agent, followed by an air entraining agent, (b) the use of the material for lining (preferably brick) chimneys, and (c) chimneys lined with this material.

documents.title: Paederia foetida extracts standardised in total antidiabetic agent and antioxidant content
documents.abstract: The present invention relates to an extract of Paederia foetida having an antidiabetic agent and antioxidant in an amount of at least 5 % by weight of the total weight of the extract, dietary supplements and/or pharmaceutical products containing the same. More particularly, it is a standardised extract in which antidiabetic agents therein are quantified and subjected to cytotoxity test. In other words, the present invention is able to provide a standardised extract with a safe and effective dosage of antidiabetic agent extracted from Paederia foetida.   (No illustrative figure.)

documents.title: High-speed, fine-tension force rove testing apparatus
documents.abstract: The invention relates to an online checkout gear used for checking the roving tension during the high-speed spin-twisting process. The online checkout gear comprises a force sensor part; a checking end of a torsion shaft of the force sensor is fixed with a yarn guide head; a front roller yarn outlet is formed on one side of the yarn guide head, and a winding head yarn inlet is formed on the other side. The top part of the yarn guide head at the checking end is higher than a connecting line between a front roller and the yarn inlet. The invention has the advantages that the gear can be matched with the force sensor, and can be conveniently and reliably used for checking the yarn tension during the high-speed twisting movement; when the machine stops, the force sensor can be subjected to the zero adjustment under the condition that the yarn is not disconnected and under the action of a magnetic inductive loop, thereby ensuring the accuracy of the micro-tension online checkout.

documents.title: Systems and methods for signaling tile structures for pictures of coded video.
documents.abstract: This disclosure relates to video coding and more particularly to techniques for signaling of tile structures for pictures of coded video. According to an aspect of an invention, a first flag syntax and a second flag syntax are coded in a picture parameter set, wherein the first flag syntax specifies whether tiles within each slice are in raster scan order or the tiles within each slice cover a rectangular region of a picture and the second flag syntax specifies each slice includes only one rectangular region or each slice includes one or more rectangular regions.

documents.title: Concrete pipe with corrosion-resistant lining
documents.abstract: The concrete pipes (2) have a plug end (3) and a socket end (4). They are fitted with a plastic lining (1) which extends over the face (20) of the socket end.

documents.title: Geli̇şti̇rme ve i̇şleti̇m mi̇kro servi̇s dağitim yöntemi̇ni̇n bi̇r ayiklama, dönüştürme, yükleme araci üzeri̇nde i̇şleti̇lmesi̇ni̇ sağlayan bi̇r si̇stem
documents.abstract: Bu buluş, sürekli entegrasyon / sürekli teslimat süreçlerini yönetmek ve otomatikleştirmek için kullanılan geliştirme tabanlı DevOps (Development& Operations- Geliştirme& İşletim) mikro servis dağıtım yönteminin bir ayıklama, dönüştürme, yükleme (Extract, Transform, Load -ETL) aracı üzerinde işletilmesini sağlayan bir sistem (1) ile ilgilidir.

documents.title: Fahrwerkgehäuse mit einer getrennten struktur
documents.abstract: A reduced-volume casing for a landing gear including a chassis for fixing and taking up loads, to which the landing gear is exposed and an envelope-type structure arranged on the chassis for taking up pressurization forces. The chassis can include, in particular, a frame which is even to the output opening of the landing gear and is provided with beams used for receiving means for maintaining the fastening bearings of the gear and also including polygons which are used for receiving the fastening bearings of the gear manoeuvring strut and are fixed to the beams, wherein the beams and polygons form a lattice structure.

documents.title: Preparation method of monomer composition for synthesising recycled plastic
documents.abstract:
The present invention relates to a method for preparing a 
monomer composition for synthesizing recycled plastic. The method comprising the steps of: subjecting a polycarbonate-based resin to a depolymerization reaction; adjusting the pH of the depolymerization reaction product having a pH of 13 or more to be 8 to 12; adjusting the pH of the depolymerization reaction product whose pH is adjusted to 8 to 12 to be less than 4; and adding a crystallization solvent to the depolymerization reaction product whose pH is adjusted to less than 4 and recovering the formed aromatic diol compound crystals.

documents.title: Solid pharmaceutical dosage form
documents.abstract: Disclosed is a solid pharmaceutical dosage form comprising: lopinavir and ritonavir formulated in solid dispersion; a pharmaceutically acceptable water-soluble polymer having a glass transition temperature (Tg) of at least 50 degrees C, and a pharmaceutically acceptable surfactant having a HLB value of from 4 to 10. (62) Divided Out of 545499

documents.title: Cutting and sewing structure for sewing machine
documents.abstract: The utility model discloses a cutting and sewing structure for a sewing machine, and relates to the technical field of cloth pressing and paying off. Wherein, this a cutting sewing structure for sewing machine includes: a support; the cloth pressing mechanism is fixedly arranged at the top of the bracket; the moving mechanism is fixedly arranged at the top of the support and deviates from one side of the cloth pressing mechanism; the cutting mechanism is fixedly arranged on one side of the moving mechanism; the sewing mechanism and the cutting mechanism are horizontally arranged on one side of the moving mechanism; the cloth is pressed by the cloth pressing mechanism, and then the moving mechanism drives the cutting mechanism and the sewing mechanism to move synchronously, so that the cloth is cut and sewn simultaneously. The utility model solves the problem that the edge of cloth can be wrinkled or deviate from the preset direction due to the action of component force opposite to the action force in the precise automatic sewing process, thereby reducing the sewing quality.

documents.title: Shelter
documents.abstract: The invention relates to a shelter comprising a front support structure aligned essentially in the longitudinal direction of said shelter and including at least two front pillars (7) and a rear support structure including at least two rear pillars (8), said support structures being adapted at a distance from each other in the breadth direction of the shelter, a plurality of at least essentially horizontal rafter beams (1), aligned parallel to each other perpendicular to the longitudinal direction of said shelter and spaced at a distance from each other, the rafter beams being connected by their first ends to the rear support structure and, at a point between their first and second ends, to the first support structure, and a roof decking (2) adapted over said rafter beams (1). The rafter beams (1) of the shelter are made from laminated veneer lumber and the distance between the front pillars (7) and the rear pillars (8), located respectively adjacent to each other in the longitudinal direction of the shelter, is larger than the distance between the adjacent rafter beams (1).

documents.title: Trigger switch
documents.abstract: Disclosed a trigger switch having an insulative enclosure, a movable contact element and a sliding control device slidably mounted to the insulative enclosure. The insulative enclosure includes a case and a cover. The case has plural terminal subassemblies made of conductive metal members disposed therein. The case has an opening over which the cover is mounted. A fixed contact mounted on one of the terminal subassemblies in the case. The movable contact element has a movable contact mounted at one end of the movable contact element and located opposite to the fixed contact. The movable contact element is swingably supported on another terminal subassembly. A trigger is mounted at one end of the sliding control device. An auxiliary brush is interposed in the movable contact element. A support member is provided with an opening portion in which the auxiliary brush is engaged such that the brush is swingably supported.

documents.title: Level with vial and manufacturing method therefor
documents.abstract: A level with a level indicating vial is disclosed. The level includes a frame that defines at least one substantially flat exterior surface configured to be placed against a reference surface. The frame defines a plurality of interior surfaces. The level also includes a vial for indicating an orientation of the reference surface, and a vial holder for holding the vial in an orientation relative to the flat exterior surface of the frame. The vial holder is configured to cooperate with one of the interior surfaces of the frame to define a cavity when the vial holder contacts the interior surface. The level also includes an adhesive disposed in the cavity to secure the vial holder to the frame.

documents.title: Package, article carrier and blank therfor.
documents.abstract: A package, a carrier for packaging one or more articles and a blank for forming the carrier are disclosed. The carrier comprises an engaging panel with at least one article-receiving aperture disposed in engagement with a part of an article. The engaging panel has a first side edge, a first end edge, a corner defined by the first side and end edges, and a corner area. The article-receiving aperture comprises a first engaging edge across the corner area from the corner. The corner area is defined at least partially by the first engaging edge, and end portions of each of the first side and end edges extending from the corner, respectively. The corner area is folded with respect to the remainder of the engaging panel such that the end portion of the first side edge is angled with respect to an adjoining portion of the first side edge. Also disclosed is a package comprising an article carrier and at least one article, the at least one article having an upwardly tapered upper portion, the carrier comprising an engaging panel comprising a first, upper, ply and a second, lower, ply, the lower ply including at least one lower aperture having an annular series of lower ply tabs formed around the at least one lower aperture, wherein the lower ply tabs are angled upwardly with respect to the engaging panel such that the lower ply tabs are in face-contacting engagement with the upper portion of the at least one article, the upper ply includes at least one upper aperture arranged substantially coaxially with the at least one lower aperture and has an annular series of upper ply tabs formed around the at least one upper aperture, the upper ply tabs are angled upwardly with respect to the engaging panel such that at least some of each of the upper ply tabs is in face-contacting engagement with a respective adjacent pair of the lower ply tabs.

documents.title: 변형된 분무-건조된 지글러-나타 (전구)촉매 시스템
documents.abstract: 지글러-나타 (전구)촉매, 담체 물질 및 테트라하이드로푸란/에탄올 변형제를 포함하는 변형된 분무-건조된 지글러-나타 (전구)촉매 시스템; 폴리올레핀; 이들의 제조 방법과 사용 방법; 및 이들을 포함하는 물품에 관한 것이다.
